Tooltip_MinidoracatKnoxPass_Tag: Install it from the vehicle mechanics panel under the "Knox Pass" category (needs the car key or an unlocked door); it charges from the vehicle. Register the vehicle at a Knox Pass Gate Reader so that gate opens for it.
Tooltip_MinidoracatKnoxPass_Reader: Right-click a gate with a screwdriver to install it. Right-click the gate again to manage registered vehicles and the optional lock.
